en.console.no_save: No save file found. Run save to create one.
en.console.load_failed: Load failed. Check the Output panel.

en.console.spawned: Spawned {kind} nearby. Close the console to resume the world.

en.console.help.status: status - show base attributes, power bonuses, XP, and point balances
en.console.help.load: load - replace current player progression with the saved player
en.console.help.save: save - write the current player progression to the save file
en.console.help.debug: debug <landing|hud> <on|off> - toggle landing marker or performance/player readouts
en.console.help.spawn: spawn <civilian|hostile> - spawn one NPC nearby; it starts moving when you close the console
en.console.help.reset: reset - attributes 1, level 1, zero XP/points; keep only Power Jump and refill health/stamina
en.console.help.add: add <xp|attr|pp> <amount> - grant XP, unspent attribute points, or power points
en.console.help.help: help [command] - list commands or explain one command
en.console.welcome:
Developer console ready. Type help for commands.
Console edits stay in this session until saved. Play starts fresh; use load to restore your saved player.
en.console.hint: Enter: run command   |   Tab: autocomplete   |   Up / Down: history   |   Esc: close
en.console.title: DEVELOPER CONSOLE  /  PAUSED
en.hud.settings.visibility_help: When off, health appears while damaged or after a change; level / XP appears after earning XP. Stamina appears while draining or recovering.
en.gameplay.attributes.help: Earn 1 attribute point per level. Spend 1 point to increase an attribute by 1. Power bonuses are included in the total and shown separately as (+x).
en.hud.settings.save_failed: Applied, but could not save settings.
en.powers.title: POWERS
en.power.super_leap.name: Super Jump
en.power.super_leap.description: Unlock charged superhero jumps. The design adds capped Strength scaling to both height and forward distance.
en.power.flight.name: Flight
en.power.flight.description: Unlock normal flight at a fixed base speed. The Speed attribute increases boosted flight once its first upgrade is purchased.
en.power.super_speed.name: Speed
en.power.super_speed.description: Unlock boosted sprinting and gain +5 Speed attribute points. Speed increases boosted running and boosted flight speed and acceleration; ordinary movement and normal flight stay fixed.
en.power.ice.name: Frost
en.power.ice.description: Encase your fists in ice for additional damage.
en.power.fire.name: Fire
en.power.fire.description: Throw fireballs that build heat in the meter shared with Laser Eyes and Electric. Overheating damages you and disables all three powers until cooled.
en.power.electricity.name: Electric
en.power.electricity.description: Channel arc lightning. Shares heat with Fire and Laser Eyes; Resilience will increase shared heat capacity.
en.power.laser_eyes.name: Laser Eyes
en.power.laser_eyes.description: Fire laser beams with a heat meter shared with Fire and Electric. Damage uses fixed base values improved through power upgrades.
en.gameplay.title: PLAYER
en.gameplay.attribute.strength.description: Increases physical punch damage. Strength scaling for super jumps, dive bombs, and landing damage is planned.
en.gameplay.attribute.speed.description: Increases boosted running and boosted flight speed and acceleration. Ordinary movement and normal flight stay fixed.
en.gameplay.attribute.resilience.descriptio: Increases maximum health, stamina capacity, and resistance to flight knockdowns. Shared heat capacity scaling is planned.
en.powers.upgrade.planned_note: Buy tiers in order. Planned effects are not active yet; their purchases reserve that tier. Core unlocks can be chosen in any order.
en.powers.feedback.save_failed: Purchase applied, but saving failed. Use Pause > Save to retry.
en.power.super_leap.current: Available now: charged jumping, Greater Jump, Air Jump, and Bounding. Strength scaling is planned.
en.power.super_leap.upgrade.1.name: Greater Jump
en.power.super_leap.upgrade.1.description: Double jump height and forward distance, and raise both caps.
en.power.super_leap.upgrade.2.name: Air Jump
en.power.super_leap.upgrade.2.description: Tap Jump once while airborne for half the upward launch speed and forward boost of your fully charged Super Jump, including Greater Jump. Works while falling, but not during flight. Recharges on landing.
en.power.super_leap.upgrade.3.name: Bounding
en.power.super_leap.upgrade.3.description: Tap Jump just before or shortly after a fast, forceful landing to leap again with full Super Jump height. Preserve most forward momentum, losing a little speed each bound. Chain until too slow; Dive Bomb landings do not qualify.
en.power.super_speed.current: Available now: +5 Speed, boosted sprinting, Endurance, and wall running. Fast Reflexes is planned.
en.power.super_speed.upgrade.1.name: Endurance
en.power.super_speed.upgrade.1.description: Halve stamina drain for boosted running. Boosted flight still uses the normal drain rate.
en.power.super_speed.upgrade.2.name: Fast Reflexes
en.power.super_speed.upgrade.2.description: Dodge incoming attacks with superhuman reflexes.
en.power.super_speed.upgrade.3.name: Wall Running
en.power.flight.current: Available now: normal flight, flight boost, and Dive Bomb using the existing airborne ground slam. Strength scaling for impact damage is planned.
en.power.flight.upgrade.1.name: Flight Boost
en.power.flight.upgrade.2.name: Dive Bomb
en.power.flight.upgrade.2.description: Launch into the existing targeted ground slam while airborne. The design scales its damage with Strength.
en.power.flight.upgrade.3.name: To Be Defined
en.power.flight.upgrade.3.description: The third Flight upgrade has not been chosen yet.
en.power.strength.name: Strength
en.power.strength.description: Gain a constant +5 Strength bonus above your base attribute. Strength increases physical punch damage; scaling for super jumps, dive bombs, and landings is planned.
en.power.strength.current: Available now: +5 Strength and upgrade 2 car pickup and throwing. Charged Punch and Thunderclap are planned.
en.power.strength.upgrade.1.name: Charged Punch
en.power.strength.upgrade.1.description: Charge a punch that hits a cone in front of you and knocks enemies back.
en.power.strength.upgrade.2.name: Vehicle Throw
en.power.strength.upgrade.3.name: Thunderclap
en.power.mind.name: Mind
en.power.mind.current: Available now: the marker that points toward nearby active trouble. Mind upgrades are planned.
en.power.mind.upgrade.1.name: Anticipation
en.power.mind.upgrade.1.description: Anticipate an attack before it happens to open a counter window.
en.power.mind.upgrade.2.name: Telekinesis
en.power.mind.upgrade.2.description: Pick up cars with your mind.
en.power.mind.upgrade.3.name: Bullet Reversal
en.power.mind.upgrade.3.description: Stop bullets in front of you, then push them back at their attackers.
en.power.laser_eyes.current: This branch and the shared heat system are planned.
en.power.laser_eyes.upgrade.1.name: Efficient Beam
en.power.laser_eyes.upgrade.2.name: Focused Beam
en.power.laser_eyes.upgrade.2.description: Deal more damage the longer you hold the beam on an enemy.
en.power.laser_eyes.upgrade.3.name: Laser Spin
en.power.laser_eyes.upgrade.3.description: Spin and damage enemies all around you.
en.power.ice.current: This branch is planned; purchasing its tiers does not grant new moves yet.
en.power.ice.upgrade.1.name: Frost Breath
en.power.ice.upgrade.1.description: Slow and freeze enemies with frost breath, and extinguish fires.
en.power.ice.upgrade.2.name: Frost Armor & Wall
en.power.ice.upgrade.2.description: Gain overhealth from frost armor on a cooldown and create a frost wall.
en.power.ice.upgrade.3.name: Frost Trails
en.power.ice.upgrade.3.description: Create ice trails ahead of you and slide along them.
en.power.fire.current: This branch and the shared heat system are planned.
en.power.fire.upgrade.1.name: Charged Fireball
en.power.fire.upgrade.1.description: Charge a larger fireball with a bigger blast radius.
en.power.fire.upgrade.2.name: Dragon Breath
en.power.fire.upgrade.3.name: External Combustion
en.power.fire.upgrade.3.description: Dissipate shared heat in an explosion around you that ignites enemies. Triggers automatically at maximum heat, or activate it manually before reaching maximum.
en.power.electricity.current: This branch and the shared heat system are planned.
en.power.electricity.upgrade.1.name: Reactive Shock
en.power.electricity.upgrade.1.description: Enemies that hit you have a chance to be shocked.
en.power.electricity.upgrade.2.name: Thunderstorm
en.power.electricity.upgrade.3.name: Lightning Strike
en.power.electricity.upgrade.3.description: During a thunderstorm, call lightning down onto a circular target area.
